about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D180 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Evoque D180 has been part of the model range since 2016, and across its two generations (L538 and L551) has used the same Ingenium diesel engine family — the AJ200D and AJ150D 2.0-litre units. This engine replaced the earlier Ford-sourced Duratorq diesel and is a common sight across the wider JLR product line, particularly in the Discovery Sport and Evoque platform vehicles. The D180 sits alongside other outputs like the D150 and D165 in the Ingenium diesel lineup, offering a balanced mix of performance and economy for the compact SUV.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D engines for every Range Rover Evoque D180 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre 4-cylinder diesel fitted to the Evoque D180 from 2016 to the present day, across both the L538 and L551 generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR cooler, and gaskets as standard on every D180 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The D180 engine is a straightforward fitment for all Evoque models (L538 and L551) that were originally specified with this Ingenium diesel output. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
